title: SentinelX Finding Contract
description: Standard finding artifact emitted by standalone capability modules (X1-X13)

finding_id.description: Unique UUIDv4 identifier of the finding

tool_name.description: Name of the capability tool producing the finding (e.g. web_security_analyzer)

rule_id.description: Identifier of the rule or signature triggered

target.description: Target URI, IP, or hostname investigated

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the finding was generated

mitre_attack_id.description: Associated MITRE ATT&CK technique ID (e.g. T1190)
